source_player_exact: #шуншин в этот момент зарадка молнией танто и вторая рука чакра скальпель, передать трос и за спину к куноичи, перерезание нервов управляющих руками и ногами, не убить, обездвижить#
interpretation: 'передать трос' in context of charged tanto treated as obvious typing error for 'перерезать трос': cut hostile tether, move behind kunoichi with elite Shunshin, precisely disrupt motor innervation of upper and lower limbs with offhand chakra scalpel. Player explicit nonlethal goal; no player-invented words, voluntary choice, feeling.
location: Страна Травы, восточная застава Ивовый брод, таможенная площадка у второй повозки

sequenced_resolution.evidence: Shiki deliberately applies Raiton Заряженное оружие to existing held tantō, charges chakra scalpel in opposite hand, launches physical Shunshin on clear wet ground at the taut hostile wire. His speed and control at 1283 exceed trained kunoichi's preparatory shift. Cuts steel tether well away from patient container connection, releasing bracket tension; exterior clip stays bent, wire drops. No electric conduction damage to patient equipment established.

Shunshin passes into enemy woman's rear at ~9m from medical container. She has attempted backward curving short-blade counter and foot pivot prepared but cannot track high-speed reposition in time. Shiki makes successive chakra scalpel CONTACT precision strikes to peripheral motor nerve bundles of both upper and lower limbs, deliberately sparing central spine, major vessels and respiratory muscles. She drops weapon, loses voluntary hand control and leg support, falls onto knees then side. Awake, breathing, able to move eyes/face and speak, cannot perform purposeful hand/leg movements. No Shiki involuntary extra attacks or restraint. Injured nerves may cause long-lasting/permanent dysfunction, not a harmless temporary genjutsu or guaranteed reversible stun. No large external blood loss.

Awake woman tries to move fingers, fails, physically terrified by sensory/motor separation. Says 'Что… ты… Ты перерезал…' then 'Убей меня, если собираешься. Не оставляй так.' She does NOT die, no gratuitous torture and has not surrendered verbally to authorities; functionally disabled.

Masked river enemy left upper limb injured, uses existing water in small concentrated ground-sweeping strike instead of another large Suiton. Jun tries lateral jump but mud foothold slips, water trips him into side of customs platform, he hits right rib/chest side, stays conscious and breathing but movement inhibited by pain. Enemy elects RETREAT to waterside cover rather than finish Jun; throws smoke bomb toward north/willows, visibility drops. He is ~33m from Shiki, near prepared river routes; escape not yet fully resolved.

External gas line pressure alarm on patient thermoregulated medical case persists; physical bent external clip and gas coupler defect not repaired by severing wire. Tiyo under guard yells 'Воздух! Контейнер теряет давление!' Patient has severe respiratory muscle weakness and needs rapid attention. Jun with right chest blow says he can hold station; asks Shiki to ensure patient not taken, but is only NJC opinion; NPC autonomy. No hospital rescue group arrived.

Stamina and chakra consumed noticeably but ample remain, no extra Shiki speech or care action.
